event.title: House Merrin renounces its oath to House Varrow
event.detail: Odo Merrin breaks the oath of House Merrin. The house now bears the oathbreaker mark (x1).

event.title: House Merrin and House Halloran sign a treaty
event.detail: The treaty holds for 4 days, until 2026-10-08 (UTC).

event.title: House Dunmere rises
event.detail: The rebellion of House Dunmere has begun. The throne may be contested until 20:30 UTC.

event.title: Aldric Varrow no longer reigns
event.detail: Aldric Varrow fell while holding the crown.

event.title: Hale Dunmere of Dunmere takes the throne
The rebellion of House Dunmere ends
event.detail: House Dunmere prevailed and holds the crown.

event.title: House Ashgrove breaks its treaty with House Halloran
event.detail: Wren tears up the treaty before its term. House Ashgrove now bears the treaty-breaker mark (x1).

event.title: House Varrow claims the crown
event.detail: Aldric Varrow of House Varrow declares a claim against Hale Dunmere of Dunmere. The rebellion opens Wednesday 19:00 UTC.
